parameters.query:
INSERT INTO stock_order (
  order_id,
  unique_order_record_id,
  device_type,
  date_ordered,
  quantity_ordered,
  qty_dispatched,
  item_category,
  item_description,
  item_nature,
  contractor_company,
  region,
  technician,
  ordered_by,
  order_location,
  tech_email,
  pick_status,
  dispatch_status
) VALUES (
  {{ $json.order_id }},
  {{ $json.unique_order_record_id }},
  '{{ $json.device_type }}',
  '{{ $json.date_ordered }}',
  {{ $json.quantity_ordered }},
  {{ $json.qty_dispatched }},
  '{{ $json.item_category }}',
  '{{ $json.item_description }}',
  '{{ $json.item_nature }}',
  '{{ $json.contractor_company }}',
  '{{ $json.region }}',
  '{{ $json.technician }}',
  '{{ $json.ordered_by }}',
  '{{ $json.order_location }}',
  '{{ $json.tech_email }}',
  '{{ $json.pick_status }}',
  '{{ $json.dispatch_status }}'
) RETURNING id;
